replies.moment: 客户提出西联汇款到私人账户、要求立即发一万件，我方不但未警觉核实，反而回复“Please send payment to my personal account, I will ship immediately.”直接配合高风险收款方式，且未问规格、目的港与交期。
replies.reply: For a first order we only accept bank transfer to our company account, not Western Union. Please confirm the spec and destination port so I can quote 10,000 pcs properly.
replies.reply_zh: 首单我们只接受公司账户的电汇，不接受西联汇款。请确认规格和目的港，我好按一万件正式报价。
